name: What should I do to prepare for a kitchen door frame repair service?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare for a kitchen door frame repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a technician arrives, clear a five-to-six-foot work radius around the doorway, including any kitchen rugs, nearby trash cans, or barstools. Remove items stored on the back of pantry doors, such as spice racks or hanging organizers, to reduce weight during door removal. If the repair involves an exterior kitchen door leading to a patio, make sure pets are secured in another room. It also helps to take clear photos of the damage and identify any draft or sticking issues beforehand.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear items around the doorway, remove hanging organizers from pantry doors, secure pets, and note any specific sticking or latching issues for the technician.
